indicator.label: Level of water stress: freshwater withdrawal as a proportion of available freshwater resources
indicator.source: FAO AQUASTAT, through the World Bank API (World Development Indicators)
indicator.classSource: FAO and UN-Water, SDG indicator 6.4.2 level of water stress: no stress below 25 %, low 25-50 %, medium 50-75 %, high 75-100 %, critical above 100 % (Progress on Level of Water Stress, 2021)
indicator.classRule: A value on a threshold takes the higher class (25 % is low), except 100 %, which is high: critical means withdrawals above 100 % of available freshwater resources.
indicator.scope: A national figure: it describes total freshwater withdrawals against renewable resources for the whole country. It says nothing about the region where a crop is grown, the season, or whether the produce the UK imports is irrigated.
